thread:
Rae: Dropping a short design review — updated Playground stream UI frame. Main areas: streaming visuals, Stop vs Pause label, token counter behavior across breakpoints, and prompt library insertion patterns. Figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/stream-compact (preview).
Chen: Quick callout: we should avoid 'Pause' unless we support resumption. Recommend 'Stop' but add a clear tooltip: 'Stop generation (partial output retained)'.
Mira: Token counter: prefer small pill showing per-response tokens. On desktop hover expand to show session total + cost estimate; on mobile open a popover via chevron. Make pill non-verbal by default for screen readers and expose details in popover.
Theo: Motion: subtle shimmer while streaming; when stopped show "partial" badge. Keyboard: Esc stops stream; debounce 150ms to prevent accidental cancels. Keymap: Esc=stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter=send, Ctrl+Enter=regenerate. Telemetry: playground.stream.started, playground.stream.stopped_manual, playground.stream.regenerated.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: use aria-live="polite" or role="log" on stream container, announce only chunk boundaries, ensure all interactive controls have visible focus and 48px touch targets. Token details must be in an accessible dialog when opened.
eng-bot: Will gate behind feature flag playground.stream_compact_v1 and roll out via canary. Adding telemetry to tracking sheet.
Rae: Action items: update Figma copy and aria notes, add Esc debounce to spec, finalize tooltip/toast text, and add popover content. Any blockers?
Chen: No design blockers.
Mira: A11y will validate after first build.
Theo: Front-end ready to pick this up once docs updated.
Rae: Thanks all, handing off to eng.
